title: A monkey makes breakfast
script: In a quiet kitchen, a fictional photorealistic capuchin monkey makes toast. It opens the refrigerator, takes one large banana from the middle shelf, and places it on a plate beside the toaster. The monkey peels the banana in a close shot, takes one bite, and reacts with surprised delight when the toaster pops. It picks up the toast with both hands and settles at the table. The short must show believable fur, hands, grip, contact, balance, and persistent props.
